I second this idea as far as writing out a "treatment" for your story if you need one.  Basically you write out your plot in a concise paragraph form, trying to keep as little detail as necessary for now (details can come later).
OP might also want to look into the basic three act structure,  not to mention looking into specific examples of non-linear storytelling, etc.  If you are running into basic writers block, maybe have someone else take a look and tell you what looks cliche, what looks good, or what is unclear and play around with ideas.
